rules.executive: Executive colour = Party Type of the most recent executive row with year <= the displayed year (carried forward), full strength.
rules.legislative: Legislature colour = the category with the most seats in the latest election of the selected chamber (Lower House, or Upper House; unicameral countries show their single chamber in both modes) <= the displayed year; upper-house partial renewals without a full composition are grey; intensity scales with that category's seat share (<=20 % palest, >=80 % full colour).
rules.chevrons: Change vs the previous election of the branch: steps = |round(position now) - round(position before)| capped at 3, where position is the category value (-2 Left .. +2 Right; legislature = seat-weighted mean). All countries: average position (country count for executive, seat-weighted for legislature) vs the previous year; one chevron per 0.1 of a category step, max 3.

freedom.economic: Fraser Institute, Economic Freedom of the World: 2026 Annual Report dataset (summary index 0-10; 1970-2000 every 5 years, then annual, latest data year 2024). Gwartney, Lawson, Murphy & Mitchell (2026), www.fraserinstitute.org/economic-freedom/dataset
freedom.liberties: Freedom House, Freedom in the World (ratings and statuses 1973-2025 editions; aggregate CL/PR scores from the 2013 edition). Labelled by coverage year (edition year - 1). 2025 ratings derived from the published FIW 2026 CL/PR scores with Freedom House's score-to-rating table.
